_meta.cross_listed_rule: row dropped when its own `fund` code differs from the bar file code
_meta.dedupe_rule: first occurrence of a pid within a fund file wins
_meta.z_definition: (n_week - mean(prev 8 weeks)) / pstdev(prev 8 weeks); null when sd==0 and mean==0
